memory_update.text: MU should remain a reference anchor for the HBM/DRAM node, but not the main underfollowed discovery target because attention and market-cap are high.
FORM is a high-relevance probe-card candidate for HBM yield and known-good-die testing; future layers should quantify HBM contribution to DRAM probe-card revenue.
COHU is a lower-attention HBM inspection/test-handler candidate with explicit but still small HBM revenue guidance; survival depends on evidence that HBM revenue scales materially.
ONTO is a process-control and advanced-packaging metrology candidate; include despite large-cap status because exposure to HBM/2.5D yield gates is unusually direct.

Still need a later pass on US-listed substrate, thermal-interface-material, underfill, refurbished-enterprise-hardware, distributor, and secondary-memory-channel names; this pass mainly captured probe, test, metrology, and direct-memory anchors.

node: HBM, DRAM wafers, advanced packaging, substrates, test/inspection, and enterprise memory/storage spillovers
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe for the HBM/DRAM/advanced-packaging chokepoint with one obvious memory reference anchor and three less-obvious equipment or process-control beneficiaries. The underfollowed lane is strongest where HBM creates testing, probe-card, inspection, metrology, and yield-management bottlenecks rather than simple semiconductor-cycle exposure. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
